title: ladder/1 (D1b as built, docs/architecture/d1-roster-data.md section 5)
description: data/fighters/<id>/ladder.json: the power ladder, loaded into a LadderDef. Power fills by fillPerSec up to 100 and each threshold starts the next tier; per-tier deltas and the power-up area coefficients are open tables of numbers (their names are Simulation's). manualTierUp: when true, crossing a threshold sets formReady instead of raising the tier. Version field: schema. Policy: the top level is closed except keys starting with an underscore. Thresholds strictly increase (checked by tools/lib/xref.js).

thresholds.description: Fill levels at which each tier begins; strictly increasing (checked by tools/lib/xref.js).

tiers.description: Per-tier deltas, for example speed, damage and launch force.

manualTierUp.description: When true, crossing a power threshold sets formReady instead of raising the tier (the transformation is then chosen by the player).

reach.description: High-tier structure reach (docs/world/structure-reach.md): structure is the factor on the area in which impacts, power-ups, clashes and blasts damage structures, one per tier; ringCap the buildings one blast may level beyond the old reach, -1 for no cap.

beam.description: The beam's per-tier numbers (Encounter's step 2a): one entry for each of the four power tiers. levelCapShare and overshoot never decrease with the tier (checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js).

chargePerSec.description: Power per second while the fighter charges (Q10).

stepKinds.description: One entry per threshold: a pausing step may pause the fight (data/fight/pause.json), a live step never does (Q10).

takenPerDamage.description: Power for each point of damage a hit does to this fighter.

dealtPerDamage.description: Power for each point of damage this fighter's hit does.
